verdict.rationale: Asana has a dedicated developer portal with documented API authentication (tokens), task creation, webhooks, and rule actions, plus an llms.txt confirming structured docs accessible to AI agents; an official MCP server is also documented, further supporting programmatic/agentic access. Missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec endpoint (probe returned 404s) and no independent hands-on developer corroboration of API robustness.
